If you will laugh about it later, you can laugh about it now.

Kevin explains that we choose whether we are happy or sad, and nobody can make that choice for us unless we allow it. He paints a picture: a car crash, rain, a deserted road, a dead phone and no help in sight.

The situation is bad either way. What changes is how you meet it. If it will be funny later, it can be funny now.

What would change if you chose your mood first?

#ad #happiness #mindset #kevintrudeau

Viktor Frankl kept one freedom when everything else was taken.

Kevin points to Man's Search for Meaning. If we can control our thoughts, we can control our emotions, even when the conditions do not change.

He adds that there is no real good news or bad news. There is just news, and we put the label on it that makes us happy or sad.

What label are you putting on something right now?

#ad #mindset #happiness #kevintrudeau

Your best ideas rarely show up while you are scrolling.

Kevin explains that breakthroughs and aha moments happen in the pause. They come right before sleep, right before waking, or in the shower, when the mind goes quiet.

In that stillness, the subconscious brings up what you need. Constant doing and thinking leaves no room for it.

When do your best ideas usually show up?
